input_contract.business_objective: Kick increment Contractor — end-to-end with all 7 fixes (language hardening, legacy_code seed, refusal protocol).

relationships: LegacyInput contract must map deterministically to ModernizedOutput contract

non_negotiables: Define explicit error handling and observability requirements.
Map acceptance criteria to executable test types.

features.title: Submit Contractor Placement for Approval
features.gherkin:
Feature: Submit Contractor Placement
Scenario: Successful submission
Given a contractor is selected
When the placement details are submitted
Then the placement status is 'Pending Approval'

features.title: Approve Contractor Placement
features.gherkin:
Feature: Approve Contractor Placement
Scenario: Successful approval
Given a placement is pending approval
When the co-approver approves the placement
Then the placement status is 'Approved'

features.title: Implement Refusal Protocol
features.gherkin:
Feature: Refusal Protocol
Scenario: Refusal due to non-compliance
Given a placement is non-compliant
When the refusal protocol is triggered
Then the placement status is 'Rejected'

features.title: Error Handling in Placement Submission
features.gherkin:
Feature: Error Handling
Scenario: Error during submission
Given a network issue occurs
When the placement is submitted
Then an error message is displayed and logged

must.title: Security Compliance
must.description: Ensure the system complies with security standards.
acceptance_criteria: No critical vulnerabilities are found in security scans.
Security patches are applied within 48 hours of release.

must.title: System Reliability
must.description: Ensure the system is reliable and available.
acceptance_criteria: System meets the defined uptime metrics.
Redundancy is implemented for critical components.

should.title: System Performance
should.description: Ensure the system performs efficiently under load.
should.metric: System handles 1000 concurrent users with response time < 2 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Load tests confirm performance metrics are met.
No significant performance degradation under peak load.
System scales horizontally to accommodate increased load.
should.verification: Load test at 10× expected peak; measure p95/p99.

should.title: Usability
should.description: Ensure the system is user-friendly and accessible.
acceptance_criteria: User interface is intuitive and easy to navigate.
User feedback is incorporated into design improvements.

should.title: Data Portability
should.description: Ensure data can be easily exported and imported.
should.metric: Data export/import functionality covers all entities.
acceptance_criteria: Data export/import is tested for all key entities.
No data loss during export/import operations.
Exported data is compatible with common formats (CSV, JSON).
should.verification: Data migration tests and format compatibility checks.
